description: This file defines a PHP class 'TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' which subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM system. It handles the event when the 'time' module's status changes, updating widget permissions accordingly.

classes.name: TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for module status change events, specifically for the 'time' module, and updates permissions for dashboard widgets when the module's status changes.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array that maps the MODULE_STATUS_CHANGE event to the handler method 'onStatusChangeEvent'.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event. If the previous module was 'time', it updates permissions for associated dashboard widgets based on the new module status.
